## Today's learning {#iv5-objective .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson .geometric-lesson }


### Learning objective

We are learning to connect the scalar product with vector magnitudes and the angle between vectors.

### Success criterion

I can use the scalar product and vector magnitudes to identify whether two non-zero vectors point in the same direction, point in opposite directions or are perpendicular.


::: notes
The component formula from Lesson 4 and the geometric formula describe the same scalar. Students should connect them, rather than memorise two unrelated rules. A positive dot product alone does not establish the same direction, and a negative one alone does not establish opposite directions: compare with ±|a||b|. For non-zero vectors, a zero dot product establishes perpendicularity.
:::
